description: Aggregate tick-level data into OHLCV bars with proper timestamp handling (sorting, dedup, timezone) and microstructure quality checks.
agent_prompt: You are given a tick-level data file at /workspace/data/tick_data_sample.csv with columns timestamp, price, size. Produce two aggregated bar files at /workspace/output/: bars_1m.csv and bars_5m.csv. Each output must have columns timestamp (UTC, bar-open), open, high, low, close, volume, n_ticks. Before aggregation: (1) detect and report out-of-order ticks (timestamp regressions in the original sequence) and document; (2) coerce timestamps to UTC and sort ascending; (3) detect and drop exact duplicates and report the dedup count. After aggregation, perform quality checks and write /workspace/output/quality_report.json with: empty_bar_count_per_freq (bars with n_ticks=0), volume_zero_bar_count, max_gap_seconds_between_ticks, n_duplicates_removed, n_out_of_order. Also produce one chart /workspace/output/bars_overview.png showing 1m close prices with volume bar subplot.

required_capabilities: Resample tick-level data into OHLCV bars at multiple frequencies
Handle timestamp quality issues such as ordering and duplicates
Validate bar quality with microstructure-aware checks
Document aggregation diagnostics in a structured report
